name: Wall Shoulder Slide

instructions.description: Stand with the back near a wall and elbows bent.
Keep the ribs relaxed and slide the arms upward.
Stop before the shoulders shrug or discomfort appears.
Slide the arms back down under control.

performanceMetrics.notes: Record range only when measured consistently; do not force end range.
Use a consistent reviewer-defined quality scale for control and alignment.

variations.variationDescription: Wall Shoulder Slide — Supported Mobility Version: Add stable support or cushions to reduce balance or floor-access demands.

commentsNotes: Only slide as high as comfortable.
